import numpy as np

# --- Reduce perception noise by averaging several calls ---
def avg_pose(fn, name, n=8):
    ps, qs = [], []
    for _ in range(n):
        p, q = fn(name)
        ps.append(p); qs.append(q)
    p = np.mean(ps, axis=0)
    q = qs[0]
    return p, q

# Perception of nut, handle grasp, and peg
nut_center_pos, _ = avg_pose(get_object_pose, "white hollow center of the brown square nut")
grasp_pos, grasp_quat = avg_pose(sample_grasp_pose, "extruded handle of the brown square nut")
peg_pos, _ = avg_pose(get_object_pose, "brown square block")

# Fixed rigid offset from nut center to grasp (we keep the orientation unchanged while carrying)
offset = grasp_pos - nut_center_pos

# --- Grasp handle ---
open_gripper()
goto_pose(grasp_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.10)
close_gripper()

# --- Lift ---
lift_pos = grasp_pos.copy()
lift_pos[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(lift_pos, grasp_quat)

# --- Move above peg: nut center must align with peg, so ee = peg + offset ---
above_peg = peg_pos + offset
above_peg[2] = grasp_pos[2] + 0.15
goto_pose(above_peg, grasp_quat)

# --- Insert: lower nut onto the peg, keeping handle offset ---
insert_pos = peg_pos + offset
insert_pos[2] = grasp_pos[2] + 0.005  # approx. table-level height of the grasp
goto_pose(insert_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.08)

# --- Release and retreat ---
open_gripper()
retreat = insert_pos.copy()
retreat[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(retreat, grasp_quat)
goto_home_joint_position()
